name: Aristocrat
summary: While the aesthetic is widely promoted and codified by multiple fashion houses (e.g., Atelier Boz, Marble), it is most famously associated with the brand Moi-même-Moitié, which coined the term EGA (Elegant Gothic Aristocrat) to specifically describe their neutral-gendered line of clothing.
